props.name: square
props.description: skewed square frame instead of circle

props.name: src
props.description: tile image; omit for a built-in hairline pattern

props.name: offset
props.description: vertical tile offset (number = px). Source site used 0 / -300 / -600 per page

props.name: mode
props.description: fixed = viewport (use at page level); absolute = fills positioned parent

props.name: scaled
props.description: shrink to 0.8 like the source NEW! pill

props.name: collapsible
props.description: clamp to n lines with a show-more toggle

props.name: month
props.description: month shown initially (YYYY-MM); defaults to model or today

props.name: perView
props.description: slides per view; fractional ok (1.2 = peek)

props.name: legend
props.description: series names for the built-in legend, in palette order

props.name: creatable
props.description: allow creating a new option from the query; emits `create`

props.name: inline
props.description: render inline instead of inside a modal

slots.name: toolbar
slots.type: { state: { sortKey: string | null; sortDir: "asc" | "desc"; page: number; pageSize: number; query: string; selected: Set<string | number> & Omit<Set<string | number>, keyof Set<any>>; hidden: Set<string> & Omit<Set<string>, keyof Set<any>>; }; selected: T[]; }

props.name: nativeOnTouch
props.description: prefer native <input type=date> on coarse pointers (touch)

props.name: context
props.description: context-menu mode: open at pointer on right click

props.name: block
props.description: anchor renders as block (wraps an area rather than a button)

props.name: error
props.description: explicit error; otherwise read from the control's validity after submit/blur

slots.name: default
slots.type: { id: string; error: string; describedby: string | undefined; }

props.name: size
props.description: token key (2xs…xl) or any CSS length

props.name: description
props.description: text under the field; also wired via aria-describedby

props.name: numeric
props.description: digits only (inputmode numeric) or any char

props.name: separators
props.description: indexes after which to render a separator

props.name: keys
props.description: keys joined with + ; slot wins if present

props.name: variant
props.description: status = centered pill, note = muted line, separator = labelled rule, border = bordered row

props.name: name
props.description: sender name, shown in header and used for avatar initials

props.name: compact
props.description: hide avatar column (consecutive messages in a group)

props.name: threshold
props.description: px from bottom still counted as "at bottom"

props.name: topThreshold
props.description: px from top that fires `reach-top` (history load)

props.name: initial
props.description: where to open: latest message or top of transcript

props.name: hash
props.description: open when location.hash matches; open/close updates the hash (saenai-style deep links)

events.name: select
events.type: [item: { label: string; href: string; }, e: MouseEvent]

props.name: siblings
props.description: pages shown either side of current

props.name: href
props.description: render <a href> using this fn instead of buttons

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ next: string; previous: string; skip: string; submit: string; required: string; }> | undefined

props.name: watermark
props.description: watermark text; defaults to title. Pass "" to hide

props.name: handle
props.description: bottom drawer: show drag handle and allow swipe-down to close

props.name: lines
props.description: render n text lines instead of one block

props.name: color
props.description: background token: text | accent | danger | surface

props.name: once
props.description: localStorage key; splash shows once per key. Omit to show every load

props.name: stack
props.description: stack rows into label/value pairs under 800px

slots.name: cell
slots.type: { row: T; column: BlessColumn<T>; value: T[keyof T & string]; index: number; }

props.name: activation
props.description: activate on arrow key (automatic) or only on Enter/Space (manual)

props.name: mode
props.description: three-way (light/system/dark) or a single light↔dark button
